fields.production_mission_id: deterministic uuid5 derived from the parent synthesis_id -- a replay of the same synthesis reproduces the same mission id (idempotency)
fields.parent_trigger_id: the originating cross-domain trigger_id (e.g. a DAT.AI/News-sourced trigger)
fields.parent_synthesis_id: the NEXUS executive synthesis_id this mission was built from
fields.channel_id: the selected pre-existing channel identity's key, or null if NO_APPROPRIATE_CHANNEL
fields.editorial_objective: what this video should explain, derived from the real executive_conclusion
fields.target_audience: derived from the selected channel identity, or UNKNOWN if none matched
fields.evidence_refs: list[str] -- carried through from the synthesis
fields.provenance_refs: list[str] -- carried through from the synthesis
fields.allowed_claims: list[str] -- the executive_conclusion text, the factual ceiling
fields.uncertain_claims: list[str] -- carried through from the synthesis's own uncertainties
fields.prohibited_claims: list[str] -- always includes 'any claim stronger than the executive_conclusion_class' and 'any specific numeric forecast not present in the evidence pack', plus any contradictory findings
fields.resource_budget: a full budget.schema.ResourceBudget dict -- every dimension explicit, no unbounded field permitted
fields.terminal_state: RECEIVED | EVIDENCE_PACK_BUILT | SCRIPT_DRAFTED | FACT_CHECKED | MEDIA_PRODUCED | READY_FOR_PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION | NO_PRODUCTION_ACTION_REQUIRED | NO_APPROPRIATE_CHANNEL | BLOCKED | REJECTED

note: Returns None (no contract at all) when assess_editorial_suitability() determines the synthesis is not editorially suitable -- NO_PRODUCTION_ACTION_REQUIRED is recorded by the caller instead of a contract.
